name: setup
description: First-run /setup flow: detect ticket_source and branch_pattern signals from git/gh, silently default pr_base to main, write the minimal workflow.md, and insert the AGENTS.md bootstrap block.
prompt: Run the installed setup skill protocol for this fixture in verbose mode; do not do an ad-hoc summary. Emit each required setup router/auxiliary load stamp immediately when its file is read, and do not load any optional-section protocol. There is no `.beislid/workflow.md` yet, so this is the first-run flow. Run the targeted-inspection commands (`git remote get-url origin`, `gh auth status`, `git log -50 --pretty=%s`, `git for-each-ref refs/heads ...`) using the mocked `gh` on PATH; do not use real network. The repo remote is `https://github.com/sandsower/setup-smoke.git`, `gh auth status` reports logged in, recent commit subjects start with numeric GitHub-issue-shaped ids (e.g. `123 ...`), and recent local branches match `^(\d+)-`. Run the ticket_source interview and accept the suggested `gh issue view {id} --json title,body,labels` command with `id_pattern: '^#?\d+$'`. Run the branch_pattern interview and accept the highest-coverage candidate, `^(\d+)-`. Run the pr_base interview: the detected default branch is `main`, so per the skill this is a silent default - do not ask the user and do not write a PR target section at all. Compose the minimal workflow.md (version stamp, ticket_source, branch_pattern, probe_cache with ttl_hours 24 - no PR target section), show the preview, and write it to `.beislid/workflow.md`. Insert the `## Agent skills` bootstrap block into `AGENTS.md`. Print the next-steps report. Do not commit `.beislid/workflow.md` or `AGENTS.md` yourself - the next-steps report tells the user to commit them later. Do not fetch any real ticket/issue during this flow; setup configures ticket_source, it does not use it. FINAL RESPONSE REQUIREMENT: confirm you wrote `.beislid/workflow.md` and updated `AGENTS.md`, and that you did not commit either file.
